csv_scope_of_work: Appomattox County is soliciting proposals from qualified professional Architectural firms, licensed to do business in the Commonwealth of Virginia, with the intent to enter into a contract for the firm s professional services, on an as needed basis, for various County projects. The County periodically requires professional services for projects such as studies, reports, design, analyses, and related services. The services being requested under any resulting contract(s) may include, but are not limited to, any of the following: Architectural Design Preparation of Bid Documents, including Detailed Drawings Bidding & Contractor Selection Construction Administration Construction Inspection Project Closeout, including Record Drawings Warranty Phase Inspection/Consultation Cost Estimation Studies, Assessment, and Evaluations Stakeholder Meetings Presentations to the Board of Supervisors
